summary: Context.dev's free tier includes 1,000 API credits per month (a standard scrape uses 1 credit; extraction/brand calls cost more) plus a separate one-time 10K Logo Link quota — no credit card required. Free currently permits 1 concurrent core API request per organization. Accounts created before concurrency limits retain their legacy per-minute limits; the dashboard shows which applies. Work-email/personal-email RPM figures are not the current new-account limit.
claim_steps: Sign up at context.dev/signup — no credit card required.
1,000 API credits renew monthly; the separate 10K Logo Link quota is one-time.
Limit new Free-tier core API usage to 1 concurrent request per organization. If you have a legacy account, check the dashboard for its applicable per-minute limit.

social_proof.title: Web Scraping API Pricing: Plans from $0 | Context.dev
social_proof.text: Start with 1,000 free credits/mo, no credit card required. ... Pull 10K logos (one-time quota) ... Core API limits cap concurrent requests per organization: Free allows 1; Developer 10, Pro 100, Growth 250, and Scale 500. Accounts created before concurrency limits keep their per-minute limits, and the dashboard shows which applies.
